typing: n is positive; h is natural; i represents exactly a level in 0..h. The direction index runs from 0 to h−i inclusive and translates to u_i through u_h, with u_j in the n-dimensional real Euclidean space.
The finite degree subtype has exactly the even p from 4 to 2^(64(h+1)) inclusive. The degree adapter preserves p; its upper-bound proof does not introduce a premise.

The coordinate slot carrier consists of p copies of the disjoint union with K^j slots for each trailing relative j. The slot count is p*S_i; functions from these ordered slots to Fin n.val are exactly the n^(p*S_i) coordinate labels. The outer dependent sum keeps every (level, degree) block, not just the selected level.
source: hu imposes exactly the unit-sphere conditions on the deterministic directions.
binder_and_carrier_audit.standing_and_generalization: The source fixes sufficiently large n and an associated depth h. The isolated formula applies to arbitrary positive n and natural h, without claiming that these parameters give a valid hard family.
binder_and_carrier_audit.literal_function: F is the Eq. (15) sum of angularDegreeComponent on the (i,p) coordinates of the same joint ξ. WithLp.toLp packages those coordinates without a rescaling. The local function does not choose a fallback or include C_i(x), and the theorem only concerns unit directions.
binder_and_carrier_audit.exact_law: The input measure is the unconditioned stdGaussian on the full flattened Euclidean coefficient carrier, not the spatial law or the admissibility-conditioned law. The scalar mean is zero and variance is n times the sum of a_{i,p}^2, not its square root, n^2, or a radial multiple. The nonnegative coercion does not alter the mathematical variance.
